title: Euler Characteristics of a Family of Congruence Subgroups of $GL_m(\Z)$
summary: The congruence subgroups $Γ_1(m,p)$ that we consider here are subgroups of $GL_m(\Z)$ that fix the vector $(0,\dots,0,1) \mod p$, where $p\geq 5$ is a prime. We present a method and many computations of homological Euler characteristics of $GL_m(\Z)$ and $Γ_1(m,p)$ with coefficients in any highest weight representation $V$. By homological Euler characteristics we mean the alternating dimensions of cohomology of the group with coefficient in $V$.
